content:
Just a note to say that @ZhiKai Pong has updated us to the module system.

This means file imports will look different from now on. Also if you had a PR open, you will likely have a merge conflict to fix (sorry).

Something we should probably do here is add a linter to check that new files are added within the module system.

module

public import ...
public import ...

Most new files should put module on top and use public import, then put @[expose] public section before any namespace block.

@[expose] public section

namespace ...

Most other files are in this format. Please share here if there are any issues or questions.
